head: Verbo + preposição
Significado
Exemplo
rows: laugh at / apologize for / complain about
rir de / pedir desculpas por / reclamar de

lessons.title: Artigos
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: Artigos: a / an, the e sem artigo.

head: Artigo
Quando usar
Exemplo
rows: I need a car. She's an engineer.
coisa específica, já mencionada ou única
The car I bought is red. The sun is hot.
plural e incontável em geral, idiomas, refeições, a maioria de nomes de países e cidades
I like dogs. Money is important. I speak English.

items: a / an só com singular contável. **an** antes de som de vogal (an hour, an umbrella). **a** antes de som de consoante (a university).
Generalizações ficam sem artigo: *Children need love.* *People are friendly.*
Coisa específica leva the: *The people in my neighbourhood are friendly.*
Sem artigo em usos habituais: go to school, go home, be at work, be in bed.
"The life is difficult." O certo é **Life is difficult.**
"I like the music." (em geral) O certo é **I like music.**
"He is doctor." O certo é **He is a doctor.**
"I go to the work by bus." O certo é **I go to work by bus.**
"I have a good news." O certo é **I have some good news.** (news não tem plural)

exercises.prompt: She's ___ engineer and works at ___ hospital near my house. (a / an / the)
___ money doesn't buy ___ happiness. (a / an / the / sem artigo)
I love ___ coffee, but ___ coffee at this restaurant is terrible.
I go to the work by bus.
acc: I go to work by bus

lessons.title: Inglês prático, pedir para repetir e esclarecer
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Pedir para repetir e esclarecer.

head: Situação
Frases
rows: Sorry, could you repeat that? / Sorry, I didn't catch that. / Could you say that again?
Could you speak more slowly, please?
So you mean...? / Let me check: you said...?
What does ... mean? / How do you spell that? / What do you mean by...?
Yes, exactly. / That's right. / Not exactly. I meant...

items: Só "What?" soa seco. Use **Sorry, could you repeat that?**
"I don't understand nothing." O certo é **I don't understand anything.**
